q-3601.name: Question 1
q-3601.worked_solution:
The difference of cubes formula is given by

$$
{a}^{3}-{b}^{3}=(a-b)({a}^{2}+ab+{b}^{2}).
$$

Notice that we can write our expression as a difference of cubes:

$$
1-{j}^{3/2}={1}^{3}-{({j}^{1/2})}^{3}={1}^{3}-{(\sqrt{j})}^{3}
$$

Now, we factor the given expression using the difference of cubes formula:

$$
\begin{aligned}1-{j}^{3/2} & ={1}^{3}-{(\sqrt{j})}^{3} \\  & =(1-\sqrt{j})({1}^{2}+1\cdot \sqrt{j}+(\sqrt{j})^{2}) \\  & =(1-\sqrt{j})(1+\sqrt{j}+j)\end{aligned}
$$

q-37554.worked_solution:
The difference of cubes formula is given by

$$
{a}^{3}-{b}^{3}=(a-b)({a}^{2}+ab+{b}^{2}).
$$

Notice that we can write our expression as a difference of cubes:

$$
{q}^{6}-27{d}^{3}={({q}^{2})}^{3}-{(3d)}^{3}
$$

Now, we factor the given expression using the difference of cubes formula:

$$
\begin{aligned}{q}^{6}-27{d}^{3} & ={({q}^{2})}^{3}-{(3d)}^{3} \\  & =({q}^{2}-3d)(({q}^{2})^{2}+{q}^{2}\cdot 3d+(3d)^{2}) \\  & =({q}^{2}-3d)({q}^{4}+3d{q}^{2}+9{d}^{2})\end{aligned}
$$

\frac{8}{{w}^{3}}-\frac{1}{{z}^{9}}={(\frac{2}{w})}^{3}-{(\frac{1}{{z}^{3}})}^{3}
